QuestInfo.name: [Masteria] Reunion
QuestInfo.0: Cayne the Afinas Knight and the soldiers under his command are assisting Dr. Yoon's research team, and Lukan has also regained consciousness. However, with the Antellion in the hands of Naricain's followers, the world is now in danger.
